definition.interpretation: The prior measurement of 0.24 policy divergence is inconclusive; it reflects transient state-dependent variance rather than stable path-dependent preference formation. The protocol lacked necessary environmental controls to distinguish between structural memory-induced policy shifts and stochastic noise inherent to reinforcement learning training loops.
definition.limitations: The observed divergence was not validated against a non-memory control baseline in a deterministic environment, preventing causal attribution.
definition.next_step: Initiate a deterministic gridworld control experiment comparing memory-augmented and standard Markovian architectures.

definition.method: Comparative gridworld traversal in deterministic environments with fixed starting conditions.
definition.success: Identification of statistically significant policy trajectory divergence (p < 0.05) in deterministic conditions.

proposal.summary: Formalizing interpretation of prior experimental results and launching a refined, deterministic controlled experiment to isolate path-dependent preference formation.
proposal.title: Research Advancement: Path-Dependent Preference Formation
